title: Proton pump inhibitors in peptic ulcer disease management
text: Proton pump inhibitors irreversibly inhibit the gastric parietal cell H+/K+ ATPase, profoundly suppressing gastric acid secretion. This mechanism underlies their efficacy in promoting healing of peptic ulcers and, when combined with antibiotics, in eradicating Helicobacter pylori infection.
